title: HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01 Postdoctoral Fellowships
summary: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 support researcher mobility and postdoctoral projects, including research areas covered by Euratom and ERA Fellowships routes for widening countries.
reality_check: Complete only a developed proposal with a named postdoctoral candidate and supervisor. Euratom research areas are included; this European call is separate from the closed Czech MSCA Fellowships CZ scheme.
action_note: Finish eligibility, mobility-rule and submission checks for prepared proposals before 9 September; do not start a broad recruitment round now.

title: ERC Advanced Grant 2026
summary: Frontier-research funding for established principal investigators with a strong track record and ambitious scientific vision.
reality_check: ERC Advanced 2026 closed on 27 August. The separate AV CR incubator now offers support for preparation of ERC Advanced 2027.
action_note: Follow submitted 2026 proposals; direct prospective Advanced 2027 candidates to the incubator's recommended 15 September entry date.

title: Euratom - Nuclear Research and Training 2026
summary: The 2026 nuclear research and training call closes on 15 September. Topics include reactor safety, SMRs, research infrastructures, nuclear materials, stable isotopes and related nuclear research.
reality_check: Complete developed consortium proposals with a defined UJF task, budget and result. Continuation of a partnership does not imply free entry for a new independent consortium.
action_note: Confirm eligibility and final responsibilities in existing consortia; the separate 2027 fusion technology call is a preparation opportunity with different scope and timing.

title: DIGITAL Europe Large-Scale Pilots for AI and GenAI in Medical Imaging
summary: Digital Europe call line for large-scale deployment pilots of AI and GenAI tools in medical imaging workflows.
reality_check: Relevant mainly through clinical and data-hub partnerships; UJF impact is strongest when positioned on physics-informed methods and validation.

title: OP JAK - Top Research
summary: Large-scale Czech calls aimed at research excellence, capacity building, and development of major scientific teams and infrastructure.
reality_check: Relevant for institutional growth, but this is mainly a planned institutional track that needs internal prioritization long before launch.

title: GA CR Postdoc Individual Fellowship
summary: Individual postdoctoral funding scheme in the Czech Republic.
reality_check: Worth watching as an expected individual route for incoming candidates, but it still depends on a very strong applicant profile and confirmed call timing.

title: OP JAK - Vyzkumne infrastruktury II
summary: The published OP JAK schedule still plans Research Infrastructures II for October/November 2026, with a CZK 1.9 billion allocation. No open application intake is confirmed by this update.
reality_check: Prepare modernisation of eligible large research infrastructures. UJF needs the corresponding recognised infrastructure role; the published call will determine final eligibility and dates.
action_note: Prioritise an institutional technical wishlist and financing plan while monitoring the formal call announcement.

title: OP TAK - Aplikace: mezinarodni spoluprace
summary: OP TAK call supporting industrial research and experimental development in international cooperation.
reality_check: Partner-only opportunity for UJF in practice; proceed only with a clear business-driven industrial research or experimental-development case and at least one foreign partner.

title: OP TAK - Partnerstvi znalostniho transferu IV
summary: Knowledge Transfer Partnership IV closes on 21 September 2026 at 10:00 CEST. A knowledge-transfer assistant implements a concrete innovation in a company; support for the knowledge organisation's part can reach 85%.
reality_check: UJF can act as the knowledge organisation. The project must be outside Prague and transfer existing know-how into a specific company use case; it is not a substitute for basic-research funding.
action_note: Confirm the company, transfer assistant, location and innovation outcome, then finish the joint application before the 10:00 deadline.

title: OP JAK - Teaming-CZ III
summary: OP JAK Teaming-CZ III supports development of excellent research centres linked to successful Horizon Europe Teaming pipelines.
reality_check: Very high institutional fit only if UJF is already in a qualifying Teaming for Excellence pipeline; otherwise feasibility is effectively low.

title: OP JAK - Vyzkumne e-infrastruktury II
summary: Planning sources conflict: the OP JAK schedule indicates intake from November, while DotaceEU lists 10 December 2026 to 31 March 2027. Both are planning information, not confirmed call dates.
reality_check: Operating research data does not automatically make UJF an eligible e-infrastructure. A qualifying infrastructure or service role and the final call conditions are required.
action_note: Keep dates unconfirmed until the call is published; first establish the eligible e-infrastructure partner or institutional role.

title: MSMT - Program EXCELENCE
summary: Expected MSMT programme for strengthening excellent research teams and institutional research capacity.
reality_check: Strategically relevant, but the report did not find a final public call text; treat as monitoring until full competition documents are published.

title: GA CR - Swiss-Czech Lead Agency Projects 2027
summary: GA CR Lead Agency route for Swiss-Czech basic-research projects, with SNSF deadline on 1 October 2026 and Czech submission due by 8 October 2026.
reality_check: Relevant to basic physics and materials research with a concrete Swiss partner. SNSF is the evaluating agency; this does not reopen the standard GA CR project competition.
action_note: Coordinate the Swiss submission by 1 October and the follow-up Czech submission by 8 October 2026.

title: HORIZON-MSCA-2026-DN Doctoral Networks
summary: MSCA Doctoral Networks 2026 are open from 28 May 2026 with a 24 November 2026 deadline for international doctoral training consortia.
reality_check: Strong fit for nuclear data, detectors, radiochemistry, radiation protection, materials, or space instrumentation, but only for a consortium that already has a scientific theme and core partners.
action_note: Confirm the coordinator, partners, doctoral training concept and UJF role for the unchanged 24 November 2026 deadline.

title: IAEA CRP F23037 - Radiation-Induced Structural Changes in Polymers
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on data-driven prediction of radiation-induced structural changes in polymers.
reality_check: Good fit for materials-in-radiation expertise, but CRP budgets and proposal details need checking on the individual IAEA record.

title: IAEA CRP I31037 - Numerical Simulation of STELLA-2 Transient Experiments
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on numerical simulation of transient experiments at STELLA-2.
reality_check: Relevant for nuclear-safety modelling groups, with feasibility depending on specific modelling capacity and experiment alignment.

title: IAEA CRP I31043 - V&V of Design Tools for Molten Salt Reactors
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on experimental testing for verification and validation of molten-salt-reactor design tools.
reality_check: High fit for safety and experimental-validation capacity, but participation should be checked against the detailed CRP technical scope.

title: IAEA CRP I31042 - Ex-Vessel Corium Cooling
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on ex-vessel corium cooling from PIRT to accident management.
reality_check: Strong fit for severe-accident and safety expertise, but less relevant for teams focused only on basic nuclear physics.

title: AV CR PCP 05/2026 - Institutional Funding Requests
summary: PCP provides funding for defined institutional activities and eligible programme holders. New funding requests are due 12 October 2026, change requests 26 November, and both new and change requests for circuit 6 by 8 December.
reality_check: These are funding-request deadlines, not a common open nomination competition for Praemium Academiae, Lumina quaeruntur or personnel programmes. Selection or admission to the relevant programme is a separate condition.
action_note: Map already eligible activities and holders to the correct PCP circuit and request type. Apply amendment 1 for ERC-in coordination costs and ineligible expenditure; its publication date is unverified, so treat it as newly identified current wording, not a proven September change.

title: AV CR - Akademie budoucnosti 2026
summary: AV CR career support for research stays, good-practice exchange and returns after career breaks. Participation conditions are separate from the PCP institutional funding process.
reality_check: Do not infer a common open personnel call from PCP dates. Confirm the specific activity, programme admission and applicable selection procedure first.
action_note: Identify eligible stays or career-return activities and map approved participation to the appropriate PCP request.

title: AV CR ERC-in - Eligible Preparation Costs under PCP
summary: Institutional funding under PCP 05/2026 for eligible ERC preparation activities. The 12 October date is a new funding-request deadline, separate from admission to the ERC incubator and from European ERC call deadlines.
reality_check: Use the current PCP PDF including amendment 1, which adjusts coordination costs and ineligible expenditure. It does not generally permit routine grant-office administration costs. The amendment's publication date has not been reliably established.
source_label: AV CR current calls and PCP documentation
action_note: Check programme eligibility and each proposed expense against the current wording; handle ERC incubator applications under its separate recommended timetable.

title: AV CR - Lumina quaeruntur 2026
summary: Lumina quaeruntur supports development of independent scientific teams and research programmes. PCP can finance eligible holders, but is not itself the programme's nomination competition.
reality_check: The PCP date of 12 October does not establish an open Lumina quaeruntur nomination deadline. Programme selection, holder eligibility and institute co-financing must be checked separately.
action_note: Monitor the actual nomination procedure; submit PCP funding requests only for eligible holders and activities.

title: AV CR - Praemium Academiae 2026
summary: Praemium Academiae supports selected outstanding senior researchers and their scientific work. Funding through PCP is separate from selection for the award.
reality_check: Do not interpret the PCP 12 October funding deadline as an open nomination deadline for Praemium Academiae. Award-holder eligibility is a prior condition.
action_note: Verify the separate award procedure and eligible holders; assign any institutional funding request to the appropriate PCP circuit.

title: AV CR PPLZ - Postdoktorandi 2026
summary: PPLZ supports eligible postdoctoral researchers at AV CR institutes. Programme selection and institutional funding under PCP are distinct steps.
reality_check: PCP deadlines do not establish a general open postdoctoral recruitment or nomination round. Confirm the applicable PPLZ procedure and eligible researchers separately.
action_note: Check programme admission and host-group eligibility before preparing the corresponding institutional funding request.

title: AV CR - Strategie AV21 2026
summary: AV CR strategic programme platform with 15 running programmes in 2026 and selection of four new programmes expected for financing from 2027.
reality_check: Use through AV21 programme logic rather than as a normal grant; strongest UJF angles are space, nuclear technologies, radiation safety, data, and medical applications.

title: AV CR - Regionalni spoluprace 2026
summary: AV CR regional cooperation line for projects with concrete regional or local partners.
reality_check: Relevant for UJF only when there is a real regional partner and applied case, such as radiation monitoring or environmental measurement.

title: Horizon Europe Space 2026 - Critical Space Technologies
summary: HaDEA lists the critical space technologies call as open until 16 September 2026 at 17:00 CEST, replacing the previously reported 3 September deadline. Relevant topics include SPACE-03-85: High and Very High Energy Irradiation Test Facility Market Deployment, and SPACE-03-81: Radiation Hard FPGA on 7nm.
reality_check: UJF needs a concrete role in the appropriate technology consortium. The later deadline does not by itself allow entry into a consortium whose membership is already settled.
action_note: Check immediately whether any UJF team stopped preparation because of the old 3 September date, and complete viable existing proposals by 16 September, 17:00 CEST.

title: TA CR SIGMA DC2 - Industrial Chairs 2026
summary: TA CR SIGMA DC2 Industrial Chairs supports research organisations in recruiting and retaining internationally recognised applied-research experts and their teams. The call has a 500 million CZK allocation, up to 42 million CZK per project, and a maximum aid intensity of 60%.
reality_check: The competition closed on 12 August 2026 and is no longer an open opportunity.
action_note: Follow submitted proposals only; remove from new-project preparation.

title: ERC Proof of Concept 2026 - Second Deadline
summary: The second ERC Proof of Concept 2026 deadline is 17 September. The scheme supports development of results from an eligible ERC project.
reality_check: Only eligible ERC grant holders can apply, with a result from their ERC project. This is not a general technology-transfer grant for any UJF group.
action_note: Check the ERC holder and originating result, then complete an already prepared application.

title: ERC Plus Grant 2026 Watchlist
summary: ERC Plus 2026 closed on 2 September 2026.
reality_check: The 2026 call is closed and must not remain in the expected or open opportunities list.
action_note: Retain for reference and submitted-proposal follow-up only.

title: COST Open Call 2026
summary: COST Open Call 2026 remains open until 28 October at 12:00 CET. It funds research networks, meetings, training, mobility and coordination, not the underlying research costs.
reality_check: A proposal must involve at least seven COST Full or Cooperating Members, at least 50% of the participating countries must be Inclusiveness Target Countries, including Czechia, and at least 40% of proposers must be Young Researchers and Innovators under 40. One person may be a Main or Secondary Proposer in only one proposal.
action_note: Check network composition and submit by noon CET. MSMT will not launch INTER-COST or INTER-ACTION calls for USA and Bavaria in 2026 for budget reasons; do not assume follow-on national research funding. The European COST call itself is not cancelled.

title: EIC Transition 2026
summary: EIC Transition 2026 supports maturation and validation of technologies based on eligible EU-funded results, with grants up to about 2.5 million EUR.
reality_check: An eligible previous result is mandatory. Eligible origins include ERC Proof of Concept, Pathfinder/FET and certain H2020 or Horizon Europe research-infrastructure RIA projects; not every EU-funded result qualifies.
action_note: Document the eligible originating project and rights to its result before completing a prepared proposal for 16 September.

title: EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026
summary: EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026 are topic-gated calls for high-risk deep-tech research.
reality_check: Track only if a published challenge directly matches a concrete UJF technology; do not bend basic physics into deep-tech framing.
action_note: Monitor challenge fit, but do not push without a direct technology match.

title: Eurostars 3 - Call 11
summary: Eurostars 3 Call 11 closes on 10 September 2026. UJF can contribute to an innovative SME-led project; Czech funding is capped at EUR 250,000 per project with a maximum aid intensity of 80% for the Czech part.
reality_check: Only an SME may be the Czech main applicant. UJF must have an eligible company-led partnership and a concrete market-oriented R&D role.
action_note: Complete prepared proposals only, checking Czech applicant eligibility, budget limits and national submission duties.

title: TA CR THETA 2 - 4th Public Competition
summary: The fourth THETA 2 competition is open from 27 August to 21 October 2026. It supports energy transformation and modernisation with applicable research results. Maximum whole-project aid intensity is 90% in PP1, 60% in PP2 and 85% in PP3; these are not individual-participant rates.
reality_check: UJF may lead. PP2 requires at least one enterprise that will use the results; PP1 has its own priority objectives and application-guarantor rules. Screen PP2 and PP3 for instrumentation, diagnostics, materials and radiation or neutron methods with demonstrated energy use. PP3 targets longer-term technologies, typically entering at TRL 3-5; this is not a general basic-physics call.
action_note: Prioritise new autumn concepts with an energy application, subprogramme, PI, partner or guarantor and budget. SISTA closes on 21 October at 16:29:59 CEST. PP1 proposals must use the priority objective on industrial electrification revised on 7 September and align the guarantor's interest with it.

title: OP TAK STEP - Research and Development of Critical Technologies
summary: OP TAK STEP - Research and Development of Critical Technologies closed early on 11 August 2026 at 00:01 after reaching the limit for the volume of submitted applications. The former 30 September date is no longer valid.
reality_check: The intake is closed; no new application can be prepared for submission to this call.
action_note: Remove from active preparation. Retain this record only for submitted-project follow-up and reference.

title: European Partnership on Metrology - Normative Call 2026, Stage 2
summary: The 2026 Normative Call Stage 2 includes SRT-n10 on risk-aware type-testing requirements for radiation-protection dosimetry and implementation of new radiation-protection quantities.
reality_check: Stage 2 invites project proposals against selected topics; it does not automatically mean every participant had to pass an earlier project round. SRT-n10 offers a precise fit for radiation-protection dosimetry, subject to consortium and call eligibility.
action_note: Check participation through CMI and metrology partners for SRT-n10. Submit by 28 September 2026 at 23:59 CEST.

title: JRC ActUsLab Open Access 2026 - FMR, PAMEC and HC-KA
summary: JRC ActUsLab offers access to specialised facilities for actinide materials, plutonium and minor actinides, advanced fuels, molten salts, transmutation, spent fuel, and radioactive-waste research.
reality_check: This offers access to JRC laboratories, not a cash grant for the UJF budget. Check facility-specific technical feasibility, access conditions and any available travel support.
action_note: Contact FMR, PAMEC or HC-KA with a concrete experiment and submit the access proposal by 5 October 2026.

title: ERC Starting Grant 2027
summary: ERC-2027-STG is a bottom-up frontier-research call for researchers with 0-10 years of experience since PhD. The call budget is 594.1 million EUR for an estimated 373 grants; each grant offers up to 1.5 million EUR for five years, plus up to 1 million EUR in justified additional funding or up to 2 million EUR for relocation from a non-associated third country.
reality_check: High value only for an identified PI with a mature idea and credible excellence profile. Under the 2027 rules, an applicant may receive no more than one Starting and one Consolidator Grant during their career, may submit only one proposal under the 2027 work programme unless the first is declared ineligible, and may normally have only one proposal under evaluation at a time.
action_note: Continue preparation for the unchanged 14 October 2026 deadline with a named eligible PI; distinguish this European call from ERC incubator support dates.

title: GA CR-ISF Lead Agency Call 2026
summary: The first GA CR-ISF call remains announced for September 2026. This update has not verified a specific deadline or an open application intake.
reality_check: Prepare only with a concrete Israeli research partner; retain announced/monitoring status until the official call is available.
action_note: Check the formal announcement and final bilateral submission rules before treating this as an open competition.

title: European Nuclear Skills Initiative 2026
summary: HORIZON-EURATOM-2026-NRT-01-01 supports the European Nuclear Skills Initiative, including groundwork for a Nuclear Skills Academy, targeted training, regulatory expertise, and mobility programmes.
reality_check: Fit is limited to a mature European consortium for systematic education and skills retention; a standalone set of UJF training activities is insufficient.
action_note: Continue only with a concrete European education consortium and defined UJF role.

title: AV CR ERC Incubator - Preparation Support for 2027-2028
summary: New recommended support-programme entry dates were published on 4 September: 15 September 2026 for ERC Advanced 2027, 1 November 2026 for ERC Starting 2028, and 1 March 2027 for ERC Consolidator 2028. Second-round preparation applications can be sent at any time, ideally immediately after results.
reality_check: These are recommended dates for entering the AV CR support programme, not European ERC competition deadlines or PCP funding-request deadlines. There is no single hard closing date for this record.
action_note: Contact prospective Advanced 2027 candidates now for the recommended 15 September intake; match other candidates to the corresponding later preparation dates.

title: OP JAK - Open Science III
summary: Open Science III remains open for people and processes supporting FAIR data and institutional research-data management. The provider's 2 September update lists 61 submitted applications totalling CZK 251 million against a CZK 500 million allocation.
reality_check: These are submitted, not approved applications. Intake may close when submissions reach 120% of allocation, and no later than 31 March 2027. This is not a general computing or experimental-equipment modernisation call.
action_note: Decide on an institutional FAIR-data and data-management proposal; do not discard the call on an unsupported claim that its allocation is exhausted.

title: RAMP Call 2026 - Raw Materials and Circular Economy
summary: The open RAMP Call 2026 closes on 22 September. Potential UJF contributions include analysis, characterisation and materials methods for raw-material processing or recycling. Czech funding is capped at EUR 250,000 per project, with maximum aid intensity of 80%.
reality_check: At least three eligible partners from three countries are required. Materials research without a link to RAMP's raw-material and circular-economy objectives is insufficient. This is a previously omitted opportunity, not a newly launched September call.
action_note: Proceed only with a matching consortium and a concrete raw-material use case. Each Czech participant must also complete the required national annexes for TA CR.

title: Clean Energy Transition - CET Call 2026
summary: CET Call 2026 pre-proposals are due 8 October. Relevant UJF roles include materials and analytical contributions to hydrogen, renewable fuels or stationary batteries. Czech funding is capped at EUR 250,000 per project with maximum aid intensity of 80%.
reality_check: TA CR funds only specified call modules, not every CET module. This is not a general nuclear-research call and was already open before September; it is newly added to this overview.
action_note: Check that the consortium's module is eligible for Czech support and define a specific UJF role. Each Czech participant must supply the national annexes; coordinator submission alone is insufficient.

title: JRC Collaborative Doctoral Partnership 2026
summary: JRC invites institutional expressions of interest in collaborative doctoral projects by 25 September 2026. Organisations without authority to award PhDs may apply with an appropriate partner university.
reality_check: JRC does not transfer a grant to the partner. Each side finances the doctoral researcher's stay at its own institution; JRC pays for the researcher's employment during the JRC stay.
action_note: Identify a matching doctoral topic, a degree-awarding university and a viable institutional financing arrangement before submitting an expression of interest.

title: HORIZON-EURATOM-2027-01-01 - Key Enabling Technologies for Fusion Power Plants
summary: The adopted Euratom work programme plans opening on 15 September 2026 and closing on 4 March 2027, with a EUR 32 million topic budget. The three areas are heating and current drive, high-temperature superconducting magnets, and diagnostics and control.
reality_check: The topic targets TRL 6-8 and research-industry cooperation. It is not a general fusion-materials call; UJF needs a concrete role within one of the three defined technology areas.
action_note: Assess diagnostics, sensors and irradiation qualification of specific components with industrial and fusion partners, and verify the call when it opens.

title: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027
summary: ERC Consolidator 2027 is planned to open on 24 September 2026 with a deadline of 12 January 2027. The 2027 rules extend the career window to 5-15 years after the PhD.
reality_check: Prepare a specific independent PI and assess eligibility against the 2027 work programme, including applicable career-window rules and extensions.
action_note: Select a credible candidate and develop the scientific concept now; confirm final call conditions at opening.

title: OP JAK - MSCA Fellowships CZ (Closed)
summary: OP JAK MSCA Fellowships CZ closed on 31 August 2026. The provider explicitly states that applications can no longer be submitted.
reality_check: This closed Czech scheme is distinct from the European MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 call, which closes on 9 September.
action_note: No new Czech applications; follow submitted projects only and keep the European and national schemes separate.
